ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.8.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Conversations Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Allows colonists to converse dynamically using LLMs.
--- Roadmap --- Conversations tracks its own release milestones. What ships next is scoped to dialogue features in this mod - see other RimSynapse mods for their own roadmaps. 0.9 - Group Conversations: three-way and small-group dialogue around meal halls, campfires and huddled shelters, with turn-taking and reactions from listeners in earshot. 0.10 - Expansion Dialects: activate the DLC-specific flavours listed in the compatibility matrix - noble tone demands and psycast interjections (Royalty), faith debates and conversion attempts (Ideology), xenotype dialects and mechanitor comm chatter (Biotech), void whispers (Anomaly). Backlog: player-to-pawn direct dialogue, more Universe Actions (relationship shifts, inspire-to-job), and additional environmental / event triggers. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.8.0) - Event-Driven Talk, Multi-Line Delivery and Voice --- - NEW - Event-driven conversations: chit-chat and deep-talk topics are now driven by what's actually happening in your colony, with recent events weighted high and conversations pre-staged around notable moments. - NEW - Single-call multi-line conversations: a whole exchange is generated at once and drip-fed line by line to pawns in range, instead of one-shot back-and-forths. - NEW - Conversations now honour the Psychology-authored pawn voice, so each colonist sounds like themselves. - NEW - Two new agent tools: get_chat_history and get_colonist_interests. - Changed: Universe Actions now flag mutating actions, so autonomous runs respect the mutation gate. - Fixed: a no-op Universe Action mood booster now actually applies. - Performance: de-batched the per-tick environmental scan and cached reflection lookups. - Requires Core v0.8.0.
--- Changelog (v0.7.1) - Deeper, more personal conversations --- - NEW - 27 conversation topics (up from 6): small talk about weather, food, chores, animals and gossip, and deep talks about grief, regrets, beliefs, trauma, love, mortality and moral lines. - NEW - Colonists talk about their actual surroundings - the room they sleep in and the clothes they wear become conversation topics. - Conversations now draw on real memories: light recent events for small talk, long-standing burdens and specific losses for heart-to-hearts. Deep talks are richer and more personal while small talk stays brief. - Colonists no longer repeat the same topic back-to-back. - Experimental: optional background pre-seeding of conversations for instant delivery (off by default - it can serve stale context). - Requires Core v0.7.1.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables noble tone demands and psycast interjections. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables faith debates and active proselytizing. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables xenotype dialects and mechanitor comms. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables paranoid void whispers. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Colonists will naturally bring up their deep core memories, traumas, and trust levels during everyday conversations.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
